title: Resolver Decoder
text: Compute motor mechanical position and speed and sine and cosine values of motor electrical position, 3 inputs, 5 outputs, {Speed unit} sets Unit of speed output; {Computation method}, {Block Output} sets the output of block, {Number of pole-pairs for resolver} sets the resolver pole pair count, {Type of excitation method} sets the resolver excitation method Sinusoidal, {Enable input normalization} enables block to normalize inputs, {Discrete step size (s)} sets the sample time after which block executes again, {Number of pole-pairs for motor} sets the motor pole pair count, {Position offset (mechanical radians)} sets the resolver mechanical position offset, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Phase delay (electrical radians)} sets the phase delay for input signals, {Number of samples per excitation cycle} sets the samples per cycle of input signal, {Maximum application frequency (Hz)} sets the maximum applicable input frequency, {Speed filter cutoff frequency (Hz)} sets the cutoff frequency of lowpass filter, {Number of data points for lookup table} sets the size of lookup table array, {Proportional (P)} sets the proportional controller gain, {Integral (I)} sets the integral controller gain, {Error threshold (Hz)} sets the pLL error threshold 2e-2, {Position unit} sets the unit of position, {Position data type} sets the data type of angular position output, {Table data type} sets the data type of sine-cosine lookup table, {Speed data type} sets the data type of angular speed and {Base speed (RPM)} sets the base speed of the motor. Values come from the instance.
